methodology.bootstrap: paired site-clustered percentile bootstrap; resample sites with replacement, retaining all tasks per site
methodology.multiplicity: Exploratory unadjusted 95% intervals. Multiple comparisons and selecting the best on these same data increase false-positive risk; unresolved is not a tie.
methodology.cost: Total API and estimated model spend, including failures, divided by successful tasks. n/a excluded from success denominator.
methodology.pricing: Model list-price estimates; verify frozen prices before publishing.
